metadata.description: Median household income for white, non-Hispanic householders (ACS table B19013H), on the same scale as the Black-household style. Measured over all 3,158 counties with a published value: 6 classes with breaks at $45k/$60k/$70k/$80k/$95k, which fall at the 2nd/23rd/52nd/75th/90th percentile of the national distribution. Same breaks, ramp and opacity rule as the Black-household style — neither fades its noisy estimates, because fading only one of the pair would make the gap look like a difference in confidence. 0.95% of counties have a coefficient of variation above 0.3; this style does not fade them, so read median_hh_income_white_nh_moe in the GeoParquet before drawing a conclusion from any single county.
